svc_internal_line: People already on HOMATCH whose saved requirements fit this property, or who asked about it.
svc_internal_empty: No HOMATCH members match this property right now. New members are compared with it automatically.
svc_external_line: Potentially interested people discovered outside HOMATCH by your campaigns, from public conversations and listings.
svc_page_subtitle: Two services: Internal Matching inside HOMATCH, and External Matching campaigns outside it.
cw_not_found_title: This campaign could not be found
cw_not_found_body: It may belong to another account, or the link is incomplete. Your campaign history lists every campaign you started.
cw_progress_working: Working — progress appears as search steps finish
cw_progress_settled: This campaign is no longer running
cw_stage_prepare_detail: We set the languages, budget and search plan you confirmed for this property.
cw_stage_discover_detail: Public conversations and listings are being searched in the languages you chose.
cw_stage_evaluate_detail: Each finding is compared with your property: location, budget, size and how recent it is.
cw_stage_organize_detail: Duplicates are merged and results are ranked by how well they fit.
cw_stage_ready_detail: Your matches are saved to this campaign and to your property.
cw_network_caption: Sources this campaign is using, and what each has found
cw_failed_note: The search could not continue. Nothing more will be charged for work that did not run.
cw_done_body: They are ready to review, filter and contact.
cw_partial_body: The campaign did not complete every step, but these {{n}} results are real and ready to review.
cw_empty_body: The campaign finished and found no one who fits this property closely enough. Adjusting the property details or searching again later can change that.
cw_failed_body: A search provider was unavailable. You were not charged for work that did not run. You can try again.
cw_cancelled_body: This campaign was stopped before it found any matches.
cw_stop_confirm_desc: The search stops now. Results already found stay saved, and unused budget is released.
cw_history_subtitle: Every campaign you started, newest first. Open one to see its progress and matches.
cw_history_empty_body: Start a search from a property to see it here.
cw_history_error: Campaign history could not be loaded
cw_history_error_body: Please refresh the page in a moment.
cw_no_leads_yet: No results yet. They appear here as the campaign finds them.
cl_subtitle: Everyone whose details you have opened, found through your campaigns, matched on HOMATCH or imported — in one place, ready to contact.
cl_search: Search name, email, phone, source or property
cl_empty: No contacts yet. Open a match's contact details, run a campaign or import contacts to build your library.
cl_needs_email: No email address you can send to
cl_load_failed: Your contacts could not be loaded. Please refresh.
cl_privacy_note: Only contacts you have legitimately obtained appear here. Phone numbers and emails of people whose details you have not opened are never shown.
ma_subtitle: Write, translate and personalise a private message, then send it through a channel that really supports it.
ma_no_channel: None of these contacts has a channel a message can be sent on.
ma_mode_profile_dm_truth: HOMATCH cannot post into other platforms for you. Copy & open puts your message on the clipboard and opens the profile; you send it there. Delivery is not tracked.
ma_mode_homatch_chat_truth: The conversation opens with your draft filled in. Nothing is sent until you press Send there.
ma_mode_phone_truth: WhatsApp first messages must use an approved template; the campaign builder applies that, opt-outs and sending limits.
ma_mode_email_truth: Emails are designed and sent from Email Studio.
ma_tpl_first_body: Hello {{first_name|}}, I saw that you were looking for a property like mine. I would be happy to share the details and answer any questions.
ma_tpl_viewing_body: Hello {{first_name|}}, would you like to see the property in person? Tell me which days suit you and I will arrange a viewing.
ma_tpl_followup_body: Hello {{first_name|}}, I am following up on my earlier message about the property. It is still available if you are interested.
ma_instruction_ph: Describe the message, e.g. friendly, mention the balcony and the price
ma_message_ph: Write your message, or let AI draft it
ma_copied_opened: Message copied. Paste it in the profile that just opened.
ma_copy_failed: The message could not be copied. Select it and copy it manually.
ma_chat_failed: The conversation could not be opened.
ma_email_goes_to_studio: {{n}} contacts can receive email. Design and send it in Email Studio.
es_subtitle: Design an email from your property, a template or a blank page — with AI help at every step. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
es_from_property_note: A ready layout with the property's photos and real details.
es_doc_missing: That draft could not be found.
es_recipients_note: Only contacts with a valid email that never unsubscribed can be selected.
es_no_email_contacts: None of your contacts has an email address yet.
es_ai_placeholder: e.g. Create a premium email for this apartment, use the best three photos, highlight the location and price, and keep the design elegant.
es_ai_grounded: AI uses only this property's real details and public photos. You review every change before it is applied.
es_ai_no_property: No property selected: AI will not describe any specific property.
es_ai_failed: AI could not complete that. Please try again.
es_ai_rate_limited: You have used AI a lot in the last hour. Please try again a little later.
es_ai_out_of_scope: AI help is available for real-estate communication only.
es_ai_unavailable: AI writing is unavailable right now. You can keep editing by hand.
es_canvas_empty: No sections yet. Add one, or describe the email above and let AI draft it.
es_no_public_photos: This property has no public photos. Add photos to the property or paste an image address.
es_gallery_hint: Choose up to three photos. They sit side by side on desktop and stack on phones.
es_footer_unsub_note: An unsubscribe link is always added automatically under your footer.
es_divider_note: A thin line in the theme's accent colour.
es_problem_no_content: Add a heading or some text.
es_problem_image_without_source: An image section has no image — choose one or remove it.
es_problem_button_incomplete: A button needs both text and a link.
es_starter_intro:
Hello {{first_name|}},
I would like to share a property that may interest you.
es_starter_footer: You are receiving this email because you showed interest in property in this area.
es_save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
es_guard_unsub: Every email carries a one-click unsubscribe link.
es_guard_suppression: Unsubscribed, bounced or blocked addresses are skipped automatically.
es_guard_once: Each recipient receives this email once, even if sending is retried.
es_consent: I confirm these recipients may be contacted about property, and the content is accurate.
es_fix_problems: Fix the items in the Design step before sending.
es_confirm_body: "{{subject}}" will be sent now. This cannot be undone.
es_send_failed: The email could not be sent. Nothing was sent twice; you can try again.
es_nobody_eligible: No selected recipient can receive email right now ({{n}} excluded because they unsubscribed, were blocked or have no valid address).
es_delivery_note: Delivery figures come from the email provider and update as it reports them.
